program.name: Boy Scouts Handbook 1911
program.description: The merit badges in the Boy Scouts Handbook, First Edition, 1911 (Boy Scouts of America), as printed then. Historical 1911 text, not a current or official Scouting America requirement. Many of these badges are obsolete or unsafe today. You do not need to do anything unsafe. Ask a trusted adult before you try any requirement, and skip what you cannot do safely. The wording, spelling and punctuation are kept as printed. This app is unofficial and is not recognized by Scouting America. Source: Project Gutenberg eBook #29558. The book is in the US public domain because of its age. If you live outside the US, check your local law.

requirements.text: Grow at least an acre of corn which produces 25 per cent. better than the general average.
Be able to identify and describe common weeds of the community and tell how best to eliminate them.
Be able to identify the common insects and tell how best to handle them.
Have a practical knowledge of plowing, cultivating, drilling, hedging, and draining.
Have a working knowledge of farm machinery, haymaking, reaping, loading, and stacking.
Have a general acquaintance of the routine seasonal work on the farm, including the care of cattle, horses, sheep, and pigs.
Have a knowledge of Campbell's Soil Culture principle, and a knowledge of dry farming and of irrigation farming.
